entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The provincial police may not be p..."
entries.dialogueText: "The provincial police may not be perfect, but they are the first line of defense against disorder."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Crime doesn't wait for bureaucracy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Crime doesn't wait for bureaucracy. Drugs, migrants and illegal cargo slipping through weak borders... These are not issues that solve themselves with a signature."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not this again, Hugo...""
entries.dialogueText: "Not this again, Hugo..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I completely disagree.""
entries.dialogueText: "I completely disagree."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what's your advice?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what's your advice?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And yet I cannot allow the provinc..."
entries.dialogueText: "And yet I cannot allow the provinces to control security independently, as if they rule themselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then you must already know why cen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you must already know why centralization is necessary."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He leveled his gaze at me and spoke..."
entries.dialogueText: He leveled his gaze at me and spoke with a calm but pressing tone.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That depends on what you consider..."
entries.dialogueText: "That depends on what you consider more dangerous. Fragmented policing, or a sudden vacuum in law enforcement that will make the Houses furious."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Stripping the provinces of their f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stripping the provinces of their forces overnight is not a good idea, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It may strengthen the national gov..."
entries.dialogueText: "It may strengthen the national government, but it will weaken security in ways we cannot afford."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""After your abolition of provincial..."
entries.dialogueText: "After your abolition of provincial levies, I'm afraid this may act as the tipping point for the other Houses."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This will be seen as an attack aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will be seen as an attack against the autonomy of the provinces."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""To remove their control of interna..."
entries.dialogueText: "To remove their control of internal security would be seen as an attack to consolidate power under your rule."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "I'm completely aware, Hugo. I don't..."
entries.dialogueText: I'm completely aware, Hugo. I don't expect them to be happy about this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This isn't an attack on provinces...."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't an attack on provinces. It's about strengthening the central police forces."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you're against it?""
entries.dialogueText: "So you're against it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't care what the Houses think.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't care what the Houses think."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nobles never act vindictively. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobles never act vindictively. They're paragons of reason and rationality."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tipping point for what exactly?""
entries.dialogueText: "Tipping point for what exactly?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then you should start.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then you should start."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Because the moment they believe yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because the moment they believe you're casting them aside, they will also stop caring about the Crown."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A cornered noble isn't going to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "A cornered noble isn't going to be merely *unhappy*. We shouldn't let them become desperate enough to act."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You have to tell that to the Royal..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have to tell that to the Royal Houses who would be losing control over their own security."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You know what I'm talking about, R..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know what I'm talking about, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am only against making changes w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am only against making changes without accounting for the consequences."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The moment they believe you're cas..."
entries.dialogueText: "The moment they believe you're casting them aside, they may stop voicing their discontent in letters and start acting on it with force."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Having said that, I will support y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that, I will support your decision, no matter the course you choose."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If this decree weakens rather than..."
entries.dialogueText: "If this decree weakens rather than strengthens our hold on the kingdom, then yes, I am against it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why are you so concerned? With bot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why are you so concerned? With both their military and police forces gone, they will have no power to contest the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then I need to abolish their milit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I need to abolish their military forces as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have a point. It might be risk..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have a point. It might be risky to push this so quickly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you have a solution, Hugo, or j..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you have a solution, Hugo, or just more warnings?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That is why I will act first and s..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is why I will act first and strip them of the means to challenge the Crown."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's what worries me.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's what worries me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""They won't have power in the way t..."
entries.dialogueText: "They won't have power in the way they used to, but power doesn't disappear overnight. If they feel threatened, they'll fight with whatever they have left."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well, if your goal is to make ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if your goal is to make every Royal House panic at once, that would certainly do it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He chuckled but his expression rema..."
entries.dialogueText: He chuckled but his expression remained neutral.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If only they were all like House T..."
entries.dialogueText: "If only they were all like House Toras. Alas, they are not."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then just be sure they don’t feel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then just be sure they don’t feel it all at once."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If they feel threatened, they'll f..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they feel threatened, they'll fight with everything they have left."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'm afraid I must counsel against..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid I must counsel against this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then take the time to do it right...."
entries.dialogueText: "Then take the time to do it right. No need to turn a smart move into a reckless one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me in the eye."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me in the eye.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This decree will not solve our cur..."
entries.dialogueText: "This decree will not solve our current problems, only make them worse. My advice is to let it go."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am merely doing my job, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am merely doing my job, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And with the radicals taking to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with the radicals taking to the streets, this isn't something I can support."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not while protests are already spr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not while protests are already spreading."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: !(RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization == true || (RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows == true && RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public == false))
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == false)) == false

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not only risky. In these times, it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only risky. In these times, it's a death wish."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed and left the room."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed and left the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I signed the decree."
entries.dialogueText: I signed the decree.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'll see you later.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you later."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've given me a lot to consider...."
entries.dialogueText: "You've given me a lot to consider. I'll hold off on the decree for now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see your point, Hugo, but I've a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see your point, Hugo, but I've already decided to sign this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Very well... I'll send out the new..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well... I'll send out the new orders."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's very likely for the best.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's very likely for the best."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would appreciate it if my Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would appreciate it if my Grand Vizier supported my decisions."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I've given you my counsel, but the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've given you my counsel, but the decision is yours to make."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gave him the unsigned decree and..."
entries.dialogueText: I gave him the unsigned decree and called an end to our meeting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a look at the decree."
entries.dialogueText: I took a look at the decree.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't expect anything differe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't expect anything different."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to know.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good to know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Hugo.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need you to trust me on this, Hu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need you to trust me on this, Hugo."
